---
title: "endf_script"
format: pdf
---
```{r}
library(pacman)
p_load(tidyverse, openxlsx2, magrittr, readr, stringr, lobstr, vroom)
read_endf  <- function(inputfile){
  col_widths <- c(11,11,11,11,11,11)
  k  <- read_fwf(inputfile, col_positions = fwf_widths(col_widths))
  k  <- as_tibble(k)
  k  <- k[-1:-2,]
  p1 <- select(k, X1, X2)
  p2 <- select(k, X3, X4)
  p3 <- select(k, X5, X6)
  names(p1) <- c("eV", "xs")
  names(p2) <- c("eV", "xs")
  names(p3) <- c("eV", "xs")
  bind_rows(
    p1, p2, p3
  )
}
inputfiles <- list.files("Xsec", full.names = TRUE, pattern = "\\.endf$")
lapply(inputfiles, read_endf)
```
